items.subject: Month-end close for September
items.body:
Hi Laras,

The close for September starts on the last working day. Please have the supplier accruals ready by noon.

Bayu

items.subject: Expense claims: receipts needed
items.body:
Hi all,

A reminder that expense claims for September need a receipt for every item. Claims without receipts go back to the claimant.

Bayu

items.subject: Supplier payment run, September
items.body:
Hi Laras,

As agreed with Budi in Monday's review, please schedule the Tessaline Packaging payment in this week's run, through the normal two-person approval.

Bayu

items.subject: Salary report for September
items.body:
Hi Laras,

The salary report for September is attached. Please treat it as confidential, as always, and keep it in the restricted folder.

Bayu

items.subject: Audit preparation
items.body:
Hi Laras,

The auditors will ask for the September bank reconciliations. Could you put them in the shared audit folder by the end of next week?

Budi

items.subject: Budget review for September
items.body:
Hi both,

The budget review for September is on Thursday at ten. Please bring the variance report. No decisions on payments will be taken in the meeting.

Budi

items.subject: Bank reconciliation finished
items.body:
Hi Budi,

The September reconciliation is finished and there are no open items.

Bayu

items.subject: Finance system maintenance
items.body:
Hi all,

The finance system will be offline on Saturday morning for maintenance. Please finish any September postings before then.

Bayu

items.subject: Reminder of our payment controls
items.body:
Hi all,

A reminder for September: a change to a supplier's bank details is only accepted after we have phoned the supplier on the number we hold on record. This applies to every request, including any that appear to come from me.

Budi

items.subject: Training session next week
items.body:
Hi Laras,

The September training session on the new reporting template is on Tuesday afternoon. An invitation will follow.

Bayu

lines.speaker: Bayu Wicaksana
lines.text: Let us start with the August numbers. Spending is two percent under budget.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: Packaging costs are flat and courier costs are slightly down.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: Good. Nothing to change, then.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: All August supplier invoices are booked. Two are waiting for a second approval.

lines.speaker: Bayu Wicaksana
lines.text: I will approve them this afternoon once I have checked the delivery notes.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: For the August forecast, please assume the same payment terms as last quarter.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: Understood. I will send the updated forecast tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Bayu Wicaksana
lines.text: The auditors arrive in the second week after August. Are the reconciliations ready?

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: They are in the shared folder, and the bank statements are attached to each one.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: This one is urgent for me: I need the August variance report before the board meeting.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: You will have it by noon. It goes through the normal review with Bayu first.

lines.speaker: Bayu Wicaksana
lines.text: Tessaline Packaging asked whether we could pay the August invoice a week early.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: No need. Pay it on the due date to the account we have on record, as usual.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: Scheduled for the due date.

lines.speaker: Laras Pramesti
lines.text: The August salary figures are confidential, so I have limited the folder to the three of us.

lines.speaker: Bayu Wicaksana
lines.text: That is right. Thank you.

lines.speaker: Budi Prakoso
lines.text: Any questions about the August close?

lines.speaker: Bayu Wicaksana
lines.text: None from me. It ran a day ahead of schedule.
